title: Google 推出 Gemini 政府版服务：用 Agent 做政策研究、合规审
html:
Google 推出 Gemini 政府版服务：用 Agent 做政策研究、合规审

Google just announced Gemini for government services, bringing AI agents to government workflows.

- Automates policy research, regulatory compliance and document review

- Searches government records for FOIA requests and helps prepare redacted documents

- Evaluates vendor bids and audits grants, invoices and expenses

- Connects to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Oracle systems

- Uses existing access permissions, with no need to migrate data

- Includes pre-built partner agents for public records discovery and document redaction

- Supports human approval for consequential steps, with citations and audit trails

- Can run within the Assured Workloads FedRAMP High Data Boundary

- Available in preview, with the State of Missouri and the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services among the agencies involved https://t.co/ihgVTzEyAP

# Google 推出 Gemini 政府版服务：用 Agent 做政策研究、合规审

Google just announced Gemini for government services, bringing AI agents to government workflows.

- Automates policy research, regulatory compliance and document review
- Searches government records for FOIA requests and helps prepare redacted documents
- Evaluates vendor bids and audits grants, invoices and expenses
- Connects to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Oracle systems
- Uses existing access permissions, with no need to migrate data
- Includes pre-built partner agents for public records discovery and document redaction
- Supports human approval for consequential steps, with citations and audit trails
- Can run within the Assured Workloads FedRAMP High Data Boundary
- Available in preview, with the State of Missouri and the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services among the agencies involved https://t.co/ihgVTzEyAP
summary_zh: Google 发布面向政府的 Gemini 服务，把 AI Agent 引入政务流程。功能包括自动化政策研究、合规审查和文件审阅，检索政府记录处理 FOIA 申请并协助脱敏，评估供应商投标，审计拨款、发票和费用。它可连接 Google Workspace、Microsoft 365、SharePoint、Salesforce、ServiceNow 和 Oracle，沿用现有访问权限、无需迁移数据，并提供公共记录发现与文件脱敏的预置合作伙伴 Agent。重要步骤支持人工审批并附引用和审计记录，可在 FedRAMP High 数据边界内运行，目前为预览版，密苏里州和美国卫生与公众服务部等机构参与。
html_zh:
Google 推出 Gemini 政府版服务：用 Agent 做政策研究、合规审

谷歌刚刚推出了用于政府服务的 Gemini，将AI 智能体引入政府工作流程。

- 自动化政策研究、法规遵从和文件审查

- 搜索政府记录以获取 FOIA 请求并帮助准备经过编辑的文件

- 评估供应商投标并审核补助金、发票和费用

- 连接到 Google Workspace、Microsoft 365、SharePoint、Salesforce、ServiceNow 和 Oracle 系统

- 使用现有的访问权限，无需迁移数据

- 包括用于公共记录发现和文档编辑的预构建合作伙伴代理

- 通过引用和审计跟踪支持后续步骤的人工批准

- 可以在有保证的工作负载 FedRAMP 高数据边界内运行

- 密苏里州和美国卫生与公众服务部等参与机构提供预览版 https://t.co/ihgVTzEyAP
